The '''Ringali Shell Security Force''' or '''RSSF''' was a civilian security force that patrolled the [[Ringali Shell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The RSSF was founded to counter threats to public safety such as insurgents, criminal organizations and pirates, with jurisdiction in both the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa]] and [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sectors]]. It developed from a loose collection of police, colonial marshals and maverick constables into an organized security service. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], the force was more concerned with assisting ships in distress, and most of the anti-crime activities were assumed by the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]].
